fileDropzone.prompt: Drag & drop or click to upload

stepUp.codeHint: The 6-digit code we sent you by e-mail.

cell.label_one: {count} new message on {record}: open the conversation at the first new one
cell.label_other: {count} new messages on {record}: open the conversation at the first new one

last-message.columnHint: Your new messages on the order since you last read its conversation. A click opens the conversation at the first new one.

photo.cameraBusy: Another app is using the camera. Close it, or use a file.
photo.cameraDenied: The camera is blocked for this page. Allow it in the browser, or use a file.
photo.cameraFailed: The camera did not start. Try again, or use a file.
photo.cameraLive: Camera on. Take the photo when the item is in the frame.
photo.cameraOff: The camera is off. Start it, or use a file.
photo.cameraUnavailable: There is no camera here. Use a file instead.
photo.fileUnreadable: That file could not be read as a photo. Choose another one.
photo.guideFrame: Fit the item inside the frame
photo.instructions: Drag on the photo to draw, or tap to mark a spot. With the keyboard: the arrow keys move the crosshair (Shift moves further), Enter sets the start, Enter again draws the mark, Escape cancels it.
photo.prepareFailed: The photo could not be prepared. Try again.
photo.startArrow: Arrow start set at {at}. Move to where it points and press Enter.
photo.startCircle: Circle centre set at {at}. Move to its edge and press Enter.
photo.tooShort: Move the crosshair away from the start first.

priced.lockedCount_one: Priced document — you cannot open it
priced.lockedCount_other: {count} priced documents — you cannot open them

quote.label: Go to the message of {who} at {time}

state.error: The messages could not be read
state.errorBody: What you typed in the box below is kept.

keys.title: How it works
keys.quote: on a quote: go to the message
keys.esc: close a menu, drop the reply

pinbar.label: Pinned message {n} of {count}: go to it

held.offline: No connection: try again when you are back online.

intake.whatHappenedHint: What happened to the garment, and when you noticed it. Please do not describe an injury here: there is a field for it below.

photos.dialogIntro: Take a photo or choose one, then circle the problem if you like.

held.offline: No connection: try again when you are back online.

photos.intro: Photos of the garment and the damage help quality. Keep faces out of the picture.

problem.consent: Tick the consent first: the injury words are health data.
problem.occurredOnNeeded: Say the day it happened: an accident goes in the accident log.
problem.placeNeeded: Say where it happened: an accident goes in the accident log.
problem.whatHappened: Say what happened, and to the garment.

refused.failed: It could not be sent. Try again in a moment.
refused.network: No connection: nothing was sent. Try again when you are back online.

scan.intro: Point the camera at the code on the label: the serial fills in by itself.
scan.noCamera: No camera can be used here: type the serial instead.

pdf.previewUnavailable: The page preview is not available on this device. Download the document to read it.
